Shared-file workflow

Recommended for a team using a network Share

One editor at a time: click Connect Excel once and choose the shared workbook. After that, saved project and task changes are written back automatically when the browser has permission to access the Share.
Important: the browser will ask for permission to write to the selected workbook. If direct file access is unavailable, use Export Excel and replace the shared workbook manually. JSON backup remains available when needed.
